params.message:
Tagging gate: nothing published with tags outside the Gentells Standard

Every post and trend the projection writes passes App\Standard\TaggingGate,
which reads a pinned copy of Gentells Standard 0.8.0 (resources/standard/,
written by bin/sync-standard.mjs from the tag, sha256-checked by a test).

- Corrected: a retired id followed to its replacement (gen-teens to ls-teens,
  into the lifestage column) and a spelling the standard's match rule maps to
  one term (APAC, Gen Z, an element label). Ported from tools/load.mjs and
  tools/match.mjs; the standard's 234 spelling cases run against the port.
- Held: a tag that is not a term, a reserved term (gen-genbeta), a term of a
  scheme the class is not tagged with, an element fingerprint outside
  rules/elements.json. A held item that was public comes down through the
  existing full-set delete, under the existing brake.
- tagging_records keeps every decision with the standard version, the tags
  before and after, and the last public row of anything taken down. The same
  decision is written once; a fixed item is recorded as released.
- gentells:tagging-audit is the backfill over what is already published:
  dry run by default, --apply to correct in place and hold, a Markdown report
  per run, the same brake per kind.
- docs/design/tagging-gate.md and a README section describe the rule.
